description: Extracts structured article content from Business Insider, with specialized handling for slideshow/timeline articles that preserves all slides as structured data.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Extracts full article content including all slideshow slides (url); 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_slideshow: Extracts slideshow/timeline content specifically (url); 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description: Business Insider article URL to extract content from
